svg.title: Pattern score and ensemble meta-score
svg.desc: Illustration. A: ideal fate-position target, PRE in the cavity-adjacent layer and EPI above in the wild type, EPI throughout in the Fgf4 knockout. B: illustrative lineage configurations at three symbolic stages. C: an illustrative pattern-score trajectory s(t) on a schematic time axis. D: illustrative ensemble trajectories, pointwise quartiles and the meta-score S = alpha75 + alpha25 - alpha50.
